protocol: Luna-only iterative development. Round 1 tests a concise interaction contract, contextual persona interpretation, explicit task/evidence boundaries and a life-first persona generator. Fixed persona JSON, additional safety constraints, schemas, effort and token budgets are preserved. Questionnaire-format and brainstorming changes are labeled experimental conditions, not silent replacements of validated survey instruments. No target purchase/ranking/score distribution. Historical baselines are available from the prior experiment. All 20 diagnostic cases will receive a candidate response; confirmation uses fresh repeats after selection.

variants.hypothesis: A concise, coherent task contract and situated persona interpretation reduce contradictory directives and assistant-like overexplanation.

operations.pattern: (?s)### Rules for interpreting your persona.*?## Current cognitive state

operations.old: They are past events whose effects already took place and led to your current state. There could be events missing, and this fact will also be mentioned below. Use them only as context.
operations.new: These records describe received stimuli and performed actions. A received question can still be pending; a private thought is not a public answer. Missing events, if any, are indicated below.
Goals recorded before the latest stimulus; update when the activity changes:

operations.old: You can now produce your next sequence of actions for this turn, in order, and finish with DONE.
operations.new: Continue the current interaction as this person. Resolve the pending request, including a question in memory that the latest internal thought is about. Give the public contribution in TALK, update the cognitive state, then finish with DONE.

variants.hypothesis: Separate idea generation from selection on top of the coherent interaction contract.
Resolve the answer-only/explain contradiction while retaining product and deliberation wording.
Remove worked ranking anchors while preserving all options, prices and independent use.
Every field in the extracted public response must be supported by public communication, never private thinking.

operations.text:
## Evidence boundary
Extract the target person's communicated answer from their TALK actions. THINK is private; the survey text, background and intentions are not evidence of what they said. Determine response and justification independently: a public Yes/No remains valid even when no public reason is present. If no reason was stated publicly, set justification to exactly "No public justification provided." If a public reason exists, summarize only that reason. Do not fill an absent explanation from a plausible interpretation of the person.

variants.hypothesis: Replace exhaustive quotas and example biographies with a concise concrete-life specification, preserving demographics and required fields.
